Network analysis results

Network analysis results. (A) ceRNA network. The orange rectangular nodes are mRNAs (messenger RNA), the green diamond nodes are lncRNAs (long noncoding RNA), and the blue oval nodes are miRNAs (microRNA). (B) PPI (protein–protein) interaction network. Purple lines represent co‐expression relationships, red lines represent physical interactions, blue–green lines represent pathway relationships, green lines represent genetic interactions, and line thickness represents the strength of the interaction
